svg.title: cubrid-jira
svg.desc: cubrid-jira reads CUBRID JIRA issues as Markdown and previews every write as a dry run until you add --yes. A terminal shows real output: cubrid-jira search CBRD-27984 prints the issue title and metadata table, and cubrid-jira comment CBRD-27984 prints a dry-run plan for a POST to the comment endpoint with the Markdown body converted to Jira wiki markup.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.text: Read issues as Markdown. Preview every change first.

g.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
g.text: # [CBRD-27984] Zero-length BIT/VARBIT bind value is stored as NULL
# DRY RUN — no request sent. Add --yes to perform the live write.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: Real output from jira.cubrid.org, shortened. The comment was not sent.
